en.topic_title: 2 more ex-Observatory directors urge gov’t to revamp heat stress index for outdoor workers amid controversy
en.topic_summary:
Two more ex-Hong Kong Observatory (HKO) directors have urged the Labour Department to revamp a controversial heat stress warning for outdoor workers, after even record high temperatures triggered only the lowest alert.



A construction worker in Hong Kong. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. 



Lee Boon-ying and Shun Chi-ming, both former directors of the HKO, said in a jointly written op-ed in Ming Pao on Thursday that the Labour Department’s Heat Stress at Work Warning uses an incorrect heat stress
